subject: Behavioral Economics
title: Temptation Bundling
description: A micro-lesson that makes Temptation Bundling usable.

hook.text: Only listen to your favorite podcast while exercising. Suddenly the gym isn't a chore — it's the only place you get.

buildup.text: Milkman's temptation bundling pairs a desirable activity with a beneficial but unappealing one.

discovery.text: Applied to finance: review your budget only at your favorite cafe. Transfer savings before buying yourself a treat.

twist.text: The bundle works because the brain merges both activities. Reward from the treat fuels the task.

climax.text: Identify your guilty pleasures. Pair each with a financial task. The pleasure becomes the incentive for the disciplined.

punchline.text: Pair fun with finance. Both get done.

quiz.question: How does temptation bundling work?
options: By pairing a desirable activity with a beneficial but unappealing one
By making all activities equally boring
